notes.title: Seattle Indie Expo - Playtest is LIVE
notes.notes:
[b]Seattle Indie Expo is TOMORROW![/b]
[url=https://six.seattleindies.org/]https://six.seattleindies.org/[/url]
12pm-9pm PST

I will be demoing Cirrata there with 39 other cool local Seattle indie games! I will be running an open playtest on steam of the version that is being demoed at the Expo! Please fill out this super short feedback form 
[url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfYMKZpLVQiN1OCvYk-PZRd99UXS4WN6WLrqdaQOa9CqaHpuA/viewform]FEEDBACK[/url]

[url=https://www.twitch.tv/SeattleIndies]https://www.twitch.tv/SeattleIndies[/url]

I will be doing an live Q&A at around 12:40 PST

notes.title: Cirrata v00.20.57
notes.notes:

fixed ps4-5 controller  icon in control setting scaled to big and in the wrong place

fixed issue where having 2-3 controllers connected to pc might not allow you to navigate the options menu

fixed an issue where the player object was initiating the light shadow system and was also using it but it was never fully set up, causing random crashes and a decrease in performance. (edited)

fixed Discord link in game

disabled vertical wall jump

added button press indicator to red and blue spirits

added message indicator for following birdboss

added message indicator for "the path is blocked"

made stomp controls message stay on the screen longer 300 -> 600 (edited)

added "ultimate is ready" to game message system

added a few other on screen messages

added new arrow directional button indicator

fixed bleed damage killing the mini boss from full health in seconds 

fixed missing platform collision in miniboss room

added screen message after miniboss death

fixed typo in secret room frog dialog

fixed after picking up tomi cache in underground the button indicator never goes away

fixed bug where if knife ultimate hits shielded bat causes game crash

notes.title: CIRRATA - Play Test v00.20.34
notes.notes:

notes.title: Cirrata - 00.20.27
notes.notes:
Lots of bug fixes, tweaks and performance fixes as well as a [b]Checkpoint system.[/b] You can now travel from the bar to an activated checkpoint in the world.  (currently only 1 for the demo). 

[b]All that was done since last patch: [/b]

[list]
[*] fixed code issues with deactivate outside camera. some things werent deactivating still. also it was running 60x per second. now it runs 4 times per second.
[*] deleted about 5 unnecessary DRAW calls. (which are performance expensive)
[*] fixed a bug where picking up a SPIRIT would cause bat enemy alpha to go to 0 temporarily
[*] fixed unnecessary step event code in performance heavy lighting object
[*] performance fixes
[*] fixed issue where leaving your house in the beginning of the game you would sometimes be stuck
[*] fixed DoTs damage calculation for miniboss. now does a percent of max health and not a number in a set range. 
[*] lowered dot percent dmg on miniboss slightly
[*] game now saves when you beat the mini boss
[*] new checkpoint room added
[*] added checkpoints to the game. can fast travel from the bar to checkpoints
[*] fixed miniboss music not playing after being on pause menu screen
[*] fixed game player death count counter 
[*] the game no longer restarts to the title screen upon death
[*] you now are returned to the bar upon death
[*] added damage buff % to inventory screen
[*] fixed damage system across all secondary and main weapon attacks and also stomp, ground slam, and head slam.  All are now affected by all CRIT and DMG multipliers. (DoTs are on a different damage calculation) 
[*] fast travel point activation now saves game as well 
[/list]
